projects.notes: Weak source. Hosted on a consultant's ArcGIS Online account (item 'INDOT STIP (2024)', modified 2025-12-03), not by INDOT. Only DES number, route, location, WORKTYPE letter code and WORKDESC (154 distinct values; 20 listed); no cost, phase or letting date. All STIP entries are programmed work. INDOT's own server (https://gis.indot.in.gov/ro/rest/services, e.g. DOT/INDOT_NLRI_DATA/MapServer for Next Level Roads) answered HTTP 403 to every request, so nothing there could be verified.

parcels_statewide_note: Indiana's statewide layer (https://gisdata.in.gov/server/rest/services/Hosted/Parcel_Boundaries_of_Indiana_Current/FeatureServer/0, 3,682,675 parcels, verified) has NO owner name: only parcel ids (state_parcel_id, parcel_id), property address (prop_add, dlgf_prop_address), property class code and tax district. Useful for geometry and ids only.

parcels_counties.notes: City of Indianapolis/Marion County. Slow server: an unfiltered sample query timed out, a filtered query (owner name LIKE) answered. STATEPARCELNUMBER is the 18-digit state id. Value is assessed value.
Lake County, Indiana. No value field.
Hamilton County's own server, exported daily (EXPORTDATE). OWNNAME repeats the owner. Value is assessed value, AVTAXYR 2026.

parcels_counties_note: Not found or not reachable in the time allowed: Allen, St. Joseph.
summary: Projects: weak - only a consultant-hosted STIP line layer (DES number, location, work description; no cost or dates) could be verified; INDOT's own GIS server refuses requests with 403. Parcels: statewide layer has no owner names; owner layers verified for Marion, Lake and Hamilton counties.
